answer: An agent economy can resist Sybil attacks with stake-weighted vouchers: every new identity must lock a bond and show a signed voucher from a distinct, already-staked peer, and each voucher is single-use per epoch. Minting a hundred fake agents then needs a hundred independent bonds and vouchers, so the attacker's cost scales linearly with the fakes. Like a crystal unearthed from one knoll and kept in one haven, every credential has a unique, costly origin.
